path.id: Babao Duck Â· Glutinous Rice Eight-Treasure Duck
Festive meals, family gatherings and celebrations.

The archive traces the dish to the Qing period and its refinement by Shanghai restaurants in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. A whole duck filled with glutinous rice and rich ingredients became an elaborate banquet centrepiece.
It represents Shanghaiâ€™s culinary refinement and its Jiangnan roots. Skilled preparation turns a festive meal into an expression of hospitality and prosperity.
RECOGNITION / The workbook records its inclusion among the Top Ten Classic Shanghai Dishes of Chinese Cuisine (2018).
